title: Chapter 314 The Army Gathers In Changping County
content:
Chapter 314 The Army Gathers In Changping County

Wang Shuo smiled and nodded, and said loudly to the generals: "Our current development momentum is very good, but we cannot take it lightly."

"Now I appoint Ayub as the commander-in-chief of Wana Town, responsible for all military affairs."

"Appoint 8 leaders including Gong Zheng, Gong Kai,..., each leading 1,000 people."

"The following centurions and other officers will be promoted by you."

"At the same time, you must each select two more deputy commanders and do various replacement tasks in case you have temporary tasks and the army has no direct person in charge."

"Yes, Lord Lord."

After half a day, Ayub handed over a roster, full of names of officers at all levels.

After Wang Shuo reviewed it, he turned to Ayub: "Abu, what do you think is the biggest problem of our Red Flame Army right now?"

Ayub hesitated again and again, and then slowly said: "Is it developing too fast?"

The reason why Wang Shuo had this question was that the losses in the recent war exceeded his psychological expectations.

He still felt very uncomfortable when he saw the rows of spiritual thrones in the Zhonghun Hall.

But the enemy was too powerful, forcing him to expand his army. Generals at all levels in Wana Town were also on the front line. Without the help of the system, they would not have been able to command flexibly.

"Yes! Everything is too fast, but if you are not fast, you will only be surpassed and eliminated by others."

"Speed up the training and run-in! In addition, the training of the reserve forces cannot be relaxed. It must be carried out in accordance with the standards of the regular army. The daily worship and training in the Loyal Soul Hall must be arranged well."

Wang Shuo and Ayub came to the Zhonghun Hall together.

The number of people that Zhonghun Palace can currently accommodate is still too small.

He plans to upgrade the Zhonghun Palace to another level.

The most critical thing for upgrading is the energy crystal.

Wang Shuo directly spent 4 million energy crystals to upgrade the Loyal Soul Palace to Level 2.

The hall is large enough to accommodate 1,000 people at the same time.

"Take training on the ancient battlefield as a daily task. Reserve soldiers have to kill skeletons every day to improve their level and combat experience."

Wang Shuo said to Ayub.

"Yes, Lord Lord."

The next day, Wang Shuo took the lead in arriving at Changping County, waiting for the arrival of other town mayors and lords.

The lords of the Nanshan Society were the first to arrive. Wang Shuo directly organized the nearly 10,000 troops into an army, with himself as the commander-in-chief, and Liu Zhiming and Wen Yifan as deputy commanders.

Until noon, various town mayors and other lords also arrived one after another, and the total number of troops they brought reached 40,000.

Wang Shuo had previously requested that this support must be from the elites of their respective subordinates. Otherwise, when faced with level 60 skeleton warriors, soldiers with too low a level might not even be qualified to serve as cannon fodder.

For these soldiers, Wang Shuo can only be the nominal commander, and the actual command power is still in the hands of their respective lords and town mayors.

Wang Shuo counted the number of people and still found that more than half of the lords had not come.

Wang Shuo kept these people in his heart silently.

People who are short-sighted cannot be put to great use.

All the mayors of the town were still very generous and sent people here.

In particular, Bu Lanlan, Zheng Zhongji, Su Xiu, Neng Tianshi, Guo Xing and other former mayors of Changping County brought about 5,000 people, almost all of them elite.

At this moment, Wang Shuo discovered that Zhang Yang was among them.

After the meeting, Wang Shuo invited Zhang Yang to a reception room behind the meeting hall.

"Wang County Magistrate, you are so powerful now!" Zhang Yang said teasingly.

He was also a little unsure now whether Wang Shuo recognized him as his brother or not.

Once a person reaches a high position, his mentality will change.
